function.name: _app_update_basic_info
function.description: Update application basic information, including theme color, menu colors, primary/status colors, navigation bar style, and expand/collapse setting. The updateFieldList must explicitly declare which fields are updated; only fields listed in updateFieldList will be modified.

updateFieldList.description: Fields to update in this call. To clear a field, include it in this list; fields not listed here will not be updated even if values are provided.

appNameColor.description: Application name color. Recommended colors: #5B8FF9, #57CA8C, #5D7092, #FAAD14, #E86452, #56C1EC, #945FB9, #FF9845, #1E9493. Can be null or custom.

bgColor.description: Menu bar background color. Recommended colors: #5B8FF9, #57CA8C, #5D7092, #FAAD14, #E86452, #56C1EC, #945FB9, #FF9845, #1E9493. Can be null or custom.

navColor.description: Menu text color. Recommended colors: #5B8FF9, #57CA8C, #5D7092, #FAAD14, #E86452, #56C1EC, #945FB9, #FF9845, #1E9493. Can be null or custom.

colorPrimary.description: Primary color. Recommended colors: #5B8FF9, #57CA8C, #5D7092, #FAAD14, #E86452, #56C1EC, #945FB9, #FF9845, #1E9493. Can be null or custom.

colorSuccess.description: Success color. Recommended colors: #5B8FF9, #57CA8C, #5D7092, #FAAD14, #E86452, #56C1EC, #945FB9, #FF9845, #1E9493. Can be null or custom.

colorInfo.description: Info color. Recommended colors: #5B8FF9, #57CA8C, #5D7092, #FAAD14, #E86452, #56C1EC, #945FB9, #FF9845, #1E9493. Can be null or custom.

colorWarning.description: Warning color. Recommended colors: #5B8FF9, #57CA8C, #5D7092, #FAAD14, #E86452, #56C1EC, #945FB9, #FF9845, #1E9493. Can be null or custom.

colorDanger.description: Danger color. Recommended colors: #5B8FF9, #57CA8C, #5D7092, #FAAD14, #E86452, #56C1EC, #945FB9, #FF9845, #1E9493. Can be null or custom.
